jobsplus.job.jobsplus.smith.name: Blacksmith
jobsplus.job.jobsplus.smith.description: The Blacksmith works metal. Earn XP by crafting tools and armor, smelting ores into ingots and gems, and using anvils and grindstones. Powerups save armor durability, refund anvil experience and crafting materials, and make furnaces smelt faster and give extra ingots. With the Blacksmith class too, every powerup acts one rank higher.
jobsplus.job.jobsplus.hunter.name: Archer
jobsplus.job.jobsplus.hunter.description: The Archer fights at range. Earn XP by killing mobs with arrows from bows and crossbows or with thrown weapons, with bonus XP for kills from 30 or more blocks away. Melee kills pay nothing, and kills in one small area pay less the longer you stay. Powerups recover arrows and save bow and crossbow durability. With the Archer class too, every powerup acts one rank higher.
jobsplus.job.jobsplus.alchemist.name: Cleric
jobsplus.job.jobsplus.alchemist.descript: The Cleric works with potions and enchantments. Earn XP by brewing, drinking and throwing potions, enchanting items, harvesting nether wart, crafting brewing ingredients, and killing the mobs that drop them, such as blazes and witches. Powerups make beneficial effects last longer, refund enchanting experience, and save enchantments onto a book at a grindstone. With the Cleric class too, every powerup acts one rank higher.

jobsplus.job.jobsplus.warrior.name: Warrior
jobsplus.job.jobsplus.warrior.descriptio: The Warrior fights up close. Earn XP by hitting and killing mobs with melee or thrown weapons, by blocking damage with a glaive or quarterstaff, and a large bonus for killing bosses. Arrow kills pay nothing, and kills in one small area pay less the longer you stay. Powerups raise attack speed and save sword durability. With the Warrior class too, every powerup acts one rank higher.
jobsplus.job.jobsplus.rogue.name: Rogue
jobsplus.job.jobsplus.rogue.description: The Rogue strikes from hiding. Earn XP by killing mobs with melee or thrown weapons while sneaking, and by landing Backstab hits on targets that face away or are not hunting you. Powerups speed up sneaking, let you sneak closer to mobs unnoticed, turn you invisible while sneaking, and add backstab damage. With the Rogue class too, every powerup acts one rank higher.
jobsplus.job.jobsplus.beastmaster.name: Beastmaster
jobsplus.job.jobsplus.beastmaster.descri: The Beastmaster lives among animals. Earn XP by taming animals, feeding and breeding wolves, cats, parrots, horses, llamas and camels, and when your pets kill hostile mobs. Only a Beastmaster can tame dragons, and wild dragons leave Beastmasters alone. Powerups give your nearby pets Regeneration and Resistance, and Pack Bond gives you a buff for each kind of pet close by. With the Beastmaster class too, every powerup acts one rank higher.
jobsplus.job.jobsplus.cook.name: Cook
jobsplus.job.jobsplus.cook.description: The Cook makes food. Earn XP by crafting food, cooking it in furnaces and smokers, eating, and using Farmer's Delight cooking pots, cutting boards, skillets and stoves. Powerups make everything you eat more filling and make furnaces and smokers you open cook food faster. With the Cook class too, every powerup acts one rank higher.
jobsplus.job.jobsplus.merchant.name: Merchant
jobsplus.job.jobsplus.merchant.descripti: The Merchant lives on trade. Earn XP by trading with villagers, bartering gold with piglins and curing zombie villagers. Powerups add a chance of bonus emeralds on each trade and grant Hero of the Village after trading, which lowers prices. With the Merchant class too, every powerup acts one rank higher.
jobsplus.job.jobsplus.explorer.name: Explorer
jobsplus.job.jobsplus.explorer.descripti: The Explorer travels and searches. Earn XP by being the first to open loot chests, brushing suspicious blocks, fishing, swimming, and travelling by elytra or mount. Powerups speed up sprinting and swimming, add Luck for richer loot and fishing, lower villager prices and give a chance to double piglin barters. With the Explorer class too, every powerup acts one rank higher.

jobsplus.job.jobsplus.lumberjack.descrip: The Lumberjack fells whole trees. Chop a natural tree with an axe to bring it all down (sneak to cut one log), and earn XP from logs, stripping and planting saplings. Higher job levels add a chance of extra logs. Powerups speed up felling, save axe durability, double log drops and strengthen axe enchantments. With the Lumberjack class too, every powerup acts one rank higher, extra logs are twice as likely, and Timber gives more planks and saplings.

jobsplus.job.jobsplus.miner.description: The Miner breaks whole ore veins. Mine an ore with a pickaxe to clear the vein (sneak to mine one block), and earn XP from ores and stone.
